705590101.text: Hello everyone! You all seem to be in good spirits!

705590102.text: Thank you. These past few days have been very productive. Instructor Mika, Elowen, Honorary Knight and Paimon, I'm so grateful to all of you for your support.

705590103.text: Hmm, doesn't that sound a bit like an acceptance speech? Well, it does make sense! After all, Tres's work has proven to be a huge success.

705590104.text: Exactly... Tres's current surveying skills are sufficient to deal with more than ninety percent of situations in a typical knight's missions.

705590105.text: Of course, if it hadn't been for the inspiration we drew from the Honorary Knight's insights during the challenge, this training would have taken us three times as long....

705590106.text: #It just goes to show we've got great chemistry! We make a pretty good team, right, {NICKNAME}?

705590109.text: R—Really? After the Honorary Knight said that, I don't know why, but... I feel like my nerves have calmed down a little...

705590110.text: I'm always worried that if I mess up, it'll lead to exactly what Instructor Mika warned us about — "You're not the only person affected by the results."

705590111.text: Oh, come on! But you've already earned the Honorary Knight's seal of approval... If only I could hear those words someday...

705590112.text: You've done a good job too, Elowen!

705590113.text: Huh!? Really? Me? I'll... I'll keep that in mind!

705590114.text: ...Goodness, this is worthy of a huge celebration! Let me give it some thought...

705590115.text: Speaking of celebration, I have an idea... What would be better than celebrating with a hot meal? I heard Elowen's great at cooking...

705590116.text: Huh? My cooking? Well, my only cooking experience is making trail meals during the march, usually because I'd lose the draw... I mean, if you don't mind a meal that's a bit unrefined...

705590117.text: How could that be? Your cooking is well-known among the Knights of Favonius.

705590118.text: That's true... There hasn't been a single negative review...

705590119.text: Whoa! That makes Paimon even more curious! Can we pleeeease try some of your yummy cooking, Elowen?

705590120.text: Well, since everyone's so excited, I don't see why not! I suppose I just need to make some preparations...

705590121.text: Everyone prepared the ingredients and set up a makeshift kitchen together. Elowen cooked many dishes that looked quite ordinary, yet gave off an irresistible aroma...

705590122.text: Everyone sat down in a circle as if they were on a picnic, savoring this special meal...
